name: Baked Chicken & Veggie Meatballs for Baby (and Kids, Too!)
recipeIngredient: 1/4 cup applesauce or apple puree, (no sugar added)

recipeInstructions.text: Pre-heat the oven to 400 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, silicone mat or tin foil.
recipeInstructions.name: Pre-heat the oven to 400 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, silicone mat or tin foil.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, place all of the ingredients. Gently fold together with your hands or spatula  until everything is well incorporated. Let sit for 5 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: In a large bowl, place all of the ingredients. Gently fold together with your hands or spatula  until everything is well incorporated. Let sit for 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.text: Roll meat mixture into 1″ balls. I find it helps to wet your hands throughout the process.
recipeInstructions.name: Roll meat mixture into 1″ balls. I find it helps to wet your hands throughout the process.

recipeInstructions.text: Place the meatballs onto the baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes or until meatballs are cooked through and gently browned.
